text:
ashwin: heads up — after the quota enforcement rollout i'm seeing a 3-4x increase in SLO alerts in the console for tenant-scoped quotas :eyes:

maria: same. looks like the SLO evaluator fires per-raw-event before our fanout/coalesce layer. we end up with one alert per pod instead of one per tenant.

dom: that fits. current flow evaluates buckets then fanouts to notify service. we should either (A) push grouping into the evaluator or (B) add a cheap coalescing step in notify. lean toward A so the console preview matches what triggered it.

sasha: telemetry note — most of the alerts lack a consistent fingerprint (failure_reason sometimes missing). without a stable key coalescing is hard. we should normalize failure_reason at ingest.

leo: UX ask — can console show an "aggregated preview" toggle when editing an SLO alert so you can see estimated alert count for a given time window? would help validate thresholds before rollout.

ashwin: agree on both. proposed quick patch for evaluator config (pseudo):
```json
POST /internal/slo/eval-config
{
  "slo_id": "quota_burn_per_tenant",
  "group_by": ["tenant_id"],
  "aggregation_window_ms": 600000,
  "debounce_ms": 300000,
  "coalesce_key": "tenant_id|failure_reason"
}
```

maria: +1. also recommend a "noise_score" telemetry field added to alerts so we can filter out high-noise SLOs in dashboards. could be simple: (#distinct_senders / alerts_in_window).

dom: implementation concerns: adding group_by to evaluator will change cardinality calculations. we need to bound memory (LRU for groups) and instrument a fallback when groups explode. maybe cap to top-500 tenants and rest as "others".

sasha: agree. also add a preprocessing step to ensure failure_reason is canonicalized (map error variants to canonical strings) so coalesce_key is stable. i'll draft a mapping table.

leo: for rollout UX — canary the grouping change for 5% of traffic and show projected vs actual alert counts in the rollout modal. add a checkbox: "preview aggregated alerts".

ashwin: plan: sasha -> canonicalization PR, dom -> evaluator group_by w/ cap + telemetry, maria -> console preview + noise_score, leo -> rollout modal update. i'll coordinate canary. tagging @eng-oncall for watch during rollout :pray:

engbot: deployment scheduled: slo-evaluator-v2 -> canary 5% at 2026-04-02T15:00:00Z. Monitor slo_alert_rate and distinct_group_count.

ashwin: thanks — will follow up with metrics dashboard links once the canary is up.
